title: classify_qa result
description: Classify one official Q&A ruling before any oracle time is spent (design D6). TERMINATING when textual or not_examinable: both model families answer independently from the same packet and must agree (design D5); disagreement or a missing citation escalates. Strict-mode compatible: every property is required and objects are closed.

q_id.description: The ruling's number exactly as card_qa.json keys it, e.g. Q1601.

classification.description: behavioral: how play resolves -- exam it. textual: only clarifies printed data (name, traits, colour, cost wording) -- checked against card data, no oracle. not_examinable: tournament procedure, or a state no legal line of play can reach.

reasoning.description: Why this class, in terms of the question and answer text.

citation.description: Always starts with qa:<Q-number>. textual: also the printed field it clarifies (e.g. 'card_bundles/BT7-056.md traits'). not_examinable: also why no line reaches it (a general_rule.pdf section, or the procedure named).

examined_clauses.description: Clause ids (card_id#zone#index, from the packet) the ruling is about -- the scenario's covers: if behavioral. May be empty.
